newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utils Comanche 2 nuke near full power.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utils Comanche 2 nuke near full power.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co said its 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche 2 nuclear generating unit was close to full power production after being shut last Saturday for repair of a main feedwater valve.
"As of five a.m. (0600 EST), Comanche is at 92 percent (power), and it's continuing to ramp up," said a company spokeswoman.
The nearby unit 1 with identical generating capacity was running at full output, she added.
The Comanche Peak units in Glenn Rose, Texas produce about 18 percent of Texas Utilities' electricity deliveries.
